transcript.note: Round 1: four straight sides first, control corners after. Assigned all 19 Ringbahn stations to the side of the fitted box (L=15,R=82,T=24,B=91, side 67) that matches their ring-order run: bottom={11,52,8,12}, right={67,94,2}, top={24,23,104,25,98,47,48}, left={21,107,26,84}, and snapped each to that side's line (same col for L/R, same row for T/B) so ring order stays monotone along every side and the winding direction is unchanged (suggest[] was a 180-degree-reversed assignment, so it was discarded). 66 was pulled onto the top-right corner cell itself (79,25 -> 82,24), which turns it into the corner and saves one control point; the other three corners get control points at (15,24), (15,91), (82,91) so the ring stations only slide onto the nearest side instead of being dragged into the corners. Two non-ring points were folded into the same batch because the new sides would otherwise run over them: 102 (82,55) sat exactly on the new right edge between 94 and 67 (line-swallowing), moved inward to (79,55) keeping its angular order around 94/2/51/33; and 64 (43,89) would have flipped from outside to inside the new bottom edge, which would have made its edges to 53 and 56 cross the ring, so it was pushed to (43,93) to stay outside. Everything is proposed as one batch so only the final state is checked.

Round 2: same four-straight-sides plan as round 1 (box L=15 R=82 T=24 B=91, side 67; ring stations snapped to the side their ring-order run belongs to, 66 pulled onto the top-right corner cell so no control point is needed there, control points at the other three corners (15,24) (15,91) (82,91)). Round 1 reverted on exactly one iron-rule violation, so this round only adds the missing co-moving point instead of splitting the batch: around hub 67 the 360-degree order was 94>70>12>49 and pulling 67 from (87,66) in to the right edge (82,66) rotated 49 (81,70) past the direction of 12, giving 94>70>49>12. Fixing it by moving one more point: 49 -> (79,70), which puts it back on the far side of 12's direction (127 deg vs 112 deg) while staying inside the box and off the new right edge. The other two co-moving points are kept: 102 (82,55) -> (79,55) because it sat exactly on the new right edge between 94 and 67 (point-on-line), and 64 (43,89) -> (43,93) because the new bottom edge would otherwise have swept past it and turned its links to 53/56 into ring crossings.
